categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and modifies test/functional/feature_torcontrol.py to eliminate a timing race in the mock Tor server.
categories.rationale: Fixes an intermittent CI test failure in feature_torcontrol.py caused by a timing race on slow platforms. As reported in issue #36934, thread scheduling delays could cause bitcoind to reconnect before polling checks begin; recording explicit reconnect timestamps restores reliable CI signal, which is a primary concern for test infrastructure.
